observation.command:
grep -E "url|username|password" /opt/deegree/jdbc/inspireplu.xml; echo "=== grant schema perms to xplanbox app user ==="
su - postgres -c "psql -d xplanbox -c \"GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA public, xplansyn, xplansynpre, xplansynarchive, xplan52, xplan52pre, xplan52archive, xplan50, xplan50pre, xplan51, xplan51pre, xplan53, xplan53pre, xplan54, xplan54pre, xplan40, xplan40pre, xplan41, xplan41pre, xplan60, xplan60pre, xplan61, xplan61pre, xplanmgr, xplanvalidator, inspireplu TO xplanbox; GRANT SELECT,INSERT,UPDATE,DELETE ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA public, xplansyn, xplansynpre, xplansynarchive, xplan52, xplan52pre, xplan52archive, xplan50, xplan50pre, xplan51, xplan51pre, xplan53, xplan53pre, xplan54, xplan54pre, xplan40, xplan40pre, xplan41, xplan41pre, xplan60, xplan60pre, xplan61, xplan61pre, xplanmgr, xplanvalidator, inspireplu TO xplanbox; GRANT USAGE ON ALL SEQUENCES IN SCHEMA public, xplansyn, xplansynpre, xplansynarchive, xplan52, xplan52pre, xplan52archive, xplan50, xplan50pre, xplan51, xplan51pre, xplan53, xplan53pre, xplan54, xplan54pre, xplan40, xplan40pre, xplan41, xplan41pre, xplan60, xplan60pre, xplan61, xplan61pre, xplanmgr, xplanvalidator, inspireplu TO xplanbox;\"" 2>&1 | tail -3
